reserveReview.rationale: Restated onto the audited period end so the composition and the independent attestor's report cover the same date. FCC's FY2025 Form 10-K Schedule I (Reg S-X Rule 12-21, investments of unaffiliated issuers as of December 31, 2025) reports $242.941 million of UMB Bank repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities maturing 1/2/2026 and nine U.S. Treasury bills totalling $84.647 million maturing between 1/6/2026 and 2/24/2026, for $327.588 million of investments. Schedule V (Rule 12-27, qualified assets on deposit) adds $1.182 million of cash at UMB Bank, $0.700 million at Flagstar Bank and $0.056 million at Lead Bank (held via affiliate Figure Payments Corporation), for $329.526 million of qualified assets. Normalized weights are 73.7244%, 25.6875%, 0.3587%, 0.2124% and 0.0170%. The KPMG LLP report of independent registered public accounting firm dated 2026-03-19 states it audited the balance sheets 'including the schedules of investments' as of December 31, 2025, so these slices sit inside the audit opinion. The later 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-03-31 (accession 0001974395-26-000008) shows a comparable but larger mix ($389.556 million repo, $208.906 million T-bills, $2.362 million Goldman Sachs Financial Square money market fund, $0.700 million Flagstar cash on $601.524 million of qualified assets); that filing carries no accountant's review report and its interim statements are labelled unaudited, so it is not used as the attested composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Figure Certificate Company FY2025 Form 10-K Schedules I and V (audited qualified assets and investment schedules as of December 31, 2025)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The audited December 31, 2025 schedules identify the historical asset classes and depositaries, not current October holdings. Supplemental research on 2026-10-09T11:39:28Z recovered the newer June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q filed August 14. Its unaudited Schedule I reports Treasury bills of $273.078m, UMB repo of $82.361m and Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC repo of $200m; Schedule V totals $561.910m including interest receivable, with UMB $555.722m, Flagstar $0.700m and Lead Bank $5.488m. Schedule VI reconciles $557.494m of certificate reserve liability. These historical values are not current holdings, current token supply, independent financial assurance, or issuer redemption capacity. June unaudited schedules cannot renew the KPMG December audit or its composition clock; the audited reserve weights and custody shares remain tied to December 31.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Schedule V of the audited FY2025 10-K names the depositaries holding qualified assets: UMB Bank N.A. ($328.770 million of the $329.526 million total, custodying all investments plus cash), Flagstar Bank N.A. ($0.700 million cash) and Lead Bank ($0.056 million, the FCC-attributable portion of an account held by affiliate Figure Payments Corporation). The certificates remain unsecured obligations of FCC and the filing does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, so remoteness stays contractual-only. The filing does not state a general prohibition on reuse of the deposited collateral, so rehypothecation stays unknown.
